__readme: Allowlist for scripts/check-visibility-vocab.ts. Every entry needs a justification: WHY the claim is provable there, or the tracking id (FOUND_DEFECTS D105/D106b, docs/handoffs/access-truth-and-visibility-vocabulary.md) for its removal. Never allowlist a NEW write path that sends 'shared'/'private' to the server. Entries match by file, and by line +/-2 when line is set.
